component.name: LinuxLink
component.summary: Mix and route your audio like Elgato Wave Link

description.p: LinuxLink is an audio mixer for Linux, modelled on Elgato Wave Link 3. Split your apps into channels such as Music, Games and Voice Chat, then build independent mixes from them: one for your headphones, another for your stream or recording.

ul.li: Routing matrix with a fader and mute for every channel in every mix
Assign apps to channels once and LinuxLink remembers them
Every mix is a virtual microphone for OBS, Discord and recorders
Listen to any number of mixes on your headphones
Live level meters, microphone gain and device management
Keeps running in the system tray, starts with your computer

screenshot.caption: Channels and mixes in the routing matrix

description.p: Apps, including Steam and Proton games, are shown with their real names and icons, and new guides cover installing, common setups, an FAQ and every setting.
Bluetooth headsets become the listening device when they connect and recover from connection failures, and the microphone volume is protected when devices come and go.
Fixes silence after switching outputs, the microphone volume changing when LinuxLink starts or quits, and the AppImage missing from the app menu and taskbar.
The first release: routing matrix, app channels, up to five mixes with listen toggles, virtual microphones, device management, tray icon and automatic updates.
